killedBy: src/game/legal-content.ts is generated, not hand-edited refuses a construct it would otherwise drop on the floor
why: Reopens a hole the guard's own negative control found, rather than one written from imagination. `assertSupported` is called on every line the block walk reaches, but a bullet list's continuation-line rule consumes wrapped items BEFORE that walk sees them -- so an indented `- nested` matched the wrap rule and was appended to its parent's text as "top - nested", silently, with no throw and nothing red. This second call inside the list loop is what closes it. The failure is quiet by construction: a flattened nested list is still a list of strings, so the pane renders it, and only a fixture containing one can tell.
